title: Buckinghamshire Council: Early adoption of Microsoft Copilot
summary: Buckinghamshire reports that Copilot shortens call wrap-up and supports a deaf colleague in participating in meetings more independently.
account: Buckinghamshire reports that Copilot saves two minutes per customer-service call and 60–90 minutes daily for a monitored group of six executive assistants. A deaf colleague reportedly participates in meetings and reviews conversations with less assistance. The source does not establish whether that gain persisted. It also reports hallucinations and inconsistencies in other uses.
purpose: Support staff productivity and work quality through transcription, summarization, and drafting.
domain: Local government administration and workplace accessibility

ratings.reason: The council reports less time spent on call wrap-up and executive-assistant tasks.
